title: Promptable Closed-loop Traffic Simulation

control_signal.value: Per-agent multimodal prompts: goal points, noisy route sketches, action tags (e.g. Accelerate, LeftTurn) and free-form text instructions; prompts can be partial.

control_mechanism.value: Each prompt is encoded and pooled per agent, then added to that agent's policy query. Text goes through a LoRA-finetuned LLaMA3-8B producing language-conditioned queries, summed into the policy token.

base_model.value: Scene encoder and generator producing policy tokens, with a lightweight autoregressive Policy rolled out closed-loop; trained with imitation, collision and offroad losses.

datasets.value: ProSim-Instruct-520k, built from Waymo Open Motion Dataset (about 480K train, 48K test); Waymo Sim Agents Challenge 2024 for unconditional rollout.

metrics.value: ADE and percent gain in ADE with versus without prompts (controllability); Waymo Sim Agents composite, kinematic, interactive, map-based scores.

controllability_evidence.value: Goal Point prompt gives ADE 0.3882 m, 59.12% gain over no prompt; Text prompt 26.96% gain; all prompt types together 0.2877 m ADE, 69.71% gain.

stated_limitations.value: Arbitrary prompts unsupported: complex interactions (e.g. overtaking from the left lane) and richer modalities such as images are future work; unconditional Kinematic score is relatively low.

notes: Controllability measured indirectly as realism gain against ground truth, not prompt-adherence rate. Text prompts use an LLM, but the control signal is trained-in conditioning.
